items.why: Content is on screen for a keyboard and gone for a mouse. 1701px of it in the Explorer pattern.
The escape hatch every other record is currently forced through, and it breaks on any rebuild.
A pattern can break while the gate stays green. It already did once.
A silent unstyled render is a bad failure mode for a design system, and one app shipped that way unnoticed.
